name: council-review
description: Convene a council of distinct senior-engineer personas (Architect, Security, Operator/SRE, Pragmatist, User-Advocate, + optional bench seats) to deliberate a decision, design, or code change — each takes an independent stance, genuine disagreements surface as named cruxes, and a Chair issues a reconciled verdict that records dissents and states what would change the decision. Use when a choice has real tradeoffs and one reviewer isn't enough: architecture decisions, risky changes before merge, RFC scrutiny, 'should we adopt X?', rewrite-vs-refactor, or a pre-mortem.

model.rationale: Multi-perspective deliberation + weighted reconciliation. Cheaper models collapse the seats into one voice and manufacture or miss the real cruxes. Never downgrade.
